title: settings_save_at writes via predictable '<path>.tmp' without O_EXCL then renames over the target
detail: Predictable sibling temp path, no exclusive-create flag; a local attacker could pre-place a symlink. Payload is non-sensitive a11y settings, so impact is minimal.
recommended_fix: Write via a random suffix + O_EXCL (or os.create with exclusive) before the rename.

title: settings_load_at reads the entire dotfile before any size bound
detail: A hostile/corrupt oversized file is fully read into memory before the 6-byte check; bounds-checked afterward so impact is a transient allocation only.
recommended_fix: Stat the file first and reject > 6 bytes (or a small cap) before reading.
